OpenColumn(int, RowSelection)

Opens a column to read only the rows of selection: the pages that hold none of them are not read, and what is read is those rows one after the other, as if the others were not there. Needs the offset index of the column.

SelectRows(ParquetFilter, IEnumerable<int>)

The rows of this group that the filter may match by the page index of its columns, to be given to OpenColumn(int, RowSelection) for each of columns; null when there is nothing to gain: the filter cannot rule out a page, or one of the columns has no offset index. The rows of the pages kept that do not satisfy the filter are in it, so check them as well when the result must hold exactly.
